# Netsidian 0.6.0

Evidence-backed, portable agent memory with explicit corrections and recoverable consolidation.

- Keep memory in ordinary Markdown with structured evidence, scope, validity and source references. Existing memory entries remain readable.
- Recall bounded, filtered results; supersede, retract, dispute or resolve claims with guarded, retry-safe operations.
- Preview consolidation before writing. Apply a frozen plan to one topical document, preserve human-written sections, and recover interrupted work without silently overwriting edits.
- Detect stale derived knowledge when its sources change, with explicit status and recovery APIs.
- New focused MCP tools, REST contracts, and portable local/remote/Netsidian agent instructions. Settings support policy configuration and package export.
- Expanded failure, concurrency, API, frontend and instruction-budget validation. See `docs/agent-memory-validation.md` for results and limitations.

## Upgrade notes

Back up the SQLite database and document storage before upgrading. This release adds database migration 0010; restore a matching backup when rolling back. Legacy memory adoption is explicit. Retraction records a correction and does not erase document history. No background model or automatic knowledge regeneration is enabled.

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives cover Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon. Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires WebView2 Runtime. macOS bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not Apple notarized. Archives include installation instructions and the license.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.6.0
```

The multi-platform container supports Linux amd64 and arm64. The Helm package uses chart version and application image tag `0.6.0`. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS`; `docker-image.txt` records the immutable image digest.
